statements.status_notes: CVE-2022-1471 is exploited via snakeyaml's default Constructor, which deserializes arbitrary Java types from untrusted YAML input and can lead to remote code execution. Bumping to snakeyaml 2.x (the fix) is not possible: Cassandra 4.0 depends on the CustomClassLoaderConstructor(Class, ClassLoader) constructor that was removed in snakeyaml 2.x, so the upgrade breaks DatabaseDescriptor.daemonInitialization(). However, Cassandra 4.0 already applied the runtime mitigation in CASSANDRA-18150 ('Switch to snakeyaml's SafeConstructor'). Its YamlConfigurationLoader constructs config via a SafeConstructor subclass, which rejects tagged types and blocks the RCE exploit path. The only YAML loaded by the Stargate coordinator is operator-controlled config under /stargate/ (stargate-config.yaml, cassandra.yaml, per-module configs); no untrusted YAML deserialization occurs. The vulnerable code path is therefore not in the execute path.
